traditional.aboutText1: Traditional wood-fired ovens represent the essence of true Neapolitan pizza. Wood-fired cooking gives a unique and unmistakable flavor that only the living heat of the flame can provide.
traditional.aboutText2: Each oven is handcrafted with the highest quality refractory materials, ensuring even heat distribution and long-lasting durability.
traditional.applicationsText: Perfect for restaurants, traditional pizzerias and anyone who wants to offer the authentic Neapolitan flavor.
traditional.ctaText: Contact us for a free consultation and discover which model is perfect for your business.

gas.aboutText1: Vesuviano gas ovens combine the tradition of Neapolitan cooking with modern gas technology. They offer precise temperature control and the ability to maintain constant cooking conditions.
gas.aboutText2: Ideal for professionals who need efficiency, consistency and ease of use, without sacrificing the quality of traditional cooking.
gas.applicationsText: Perfect for modern restaurants, pizzeria chains and businesses requiring high productivity with consistent quality.
gas.ctaTitle: Want to Learn More About Gas Ovens?
gas.ctaText: Request a free consultation to discover all the advantages of our gas ovens.

electric.aboutText1: Vesuviano electric ovens represent the future of professional cooking. Thanks to digital temperature control and advanced heating systems, they guarantee perfect, constant and completely eco-sustainable cooking.
electric.aboutText2: Ideal for environments where it is not possible to install a chimney or where maximum precision in cooking is required.
electric.applicationsText: Perfect for shopping centers, food courts, urban restaurants and all activities requiring an eco-friendly solution.
electric.ctaText: Contact us for more information about our electric ovens and their applications.

rotating.aboutText1: Vesuviano rotating ovens are the ideal solution for those who need very high production volumes while maintaining excellent quality. The rotating deck ensures uniform cooking on every pizza.
rotating.aboutText2: Thanks to advanced automation and the ability to cook numerous pizzas simultaneously, these ovens are perfect for high-intensity production activities.
rotating.applicationsText: Perfect for very high volume pizzerias, chains, events and all activities requiring massive production.
rotating.ctaText: Request a consultation to discover how rotating ovens can revolutionize your production.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our artisan ovens

q1.question: Can I customize the oven for my establishment?
q1.answer: Absolutely. Each oven can be customized in painting, tile cladding, and even dome design. We also offer a free 3D render to visualize the oven in your space before production.

q2.question: Do you provide delivery and installation?
q2.answer: Yes, we handle complete transportation and installation in Italy and abroad. The oven arrives already assembled and tested, ready to use. Our technical team can also provide initial training on proper usage.

q3.question: How long does it take to receive the oven?
q3.answer: Average delivery times vary from 20 to 45 days, depending on the level of customization required. After order confirmation, you will receive a guaranteed estimated delivery date.

q4.question: Do you offer assistance or warranty?
q4.answer: All our ovens are covered by a 3-year official warranty on structure and components. Additionally, our technical center in Naples provides after-sales support and original spare parts are always available.

q5.question: How much does an oven cost?
q5.answer: Our artisan ovens start from €2,700.00 for basic models up to approximately €23,000.00 for special creations, such as the gold-plated oven we built for an exclusive client. Each project is unique and custom-made, based on production needs and desired design. To receive a personalized quote, you can request a free consultation.
